correctness.rationale: For every integer base and bin count the joint law follows by counting consecutive residues over each initial interval. Matrix-power entries follow from base-b digit concatenation. Discrete Fourier characters turn the transpose into a weighted functional graph; periodic residues are exactly those with additive order coprime to the base, giving cycle factors with telescoping product b^{-ell}. Relative entropy counts produce the exact two-mass formula and the fixed-q expansion, while the finite residue semigroup proves the independence threshold and eventual periodicity. Finite exact checks independently verify 7100 joint cells and 44 characteristic polynomials, but the infinite theorem relies on the provided analytic proof.
